text:
Priya (CS): Heads up — Vernon Health asked for a temporary APAC region enablement for an investor demo on Thu 2026-04-02. They need: 1) APAC region enabled (apac-sg1) 2) IP allowlist for demo: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.45 3) short-term QPS bump to 5k for 48h 4) auto-revoke after 72h. Also flagged renewal — they're due next month and want stability proof. Any ops issues?

Ethan (Onboard): Can you paste the customer acct id and exact timeframe? Also do they need Private/On-prem or just hosted endpoints? I can prep the onboarding checklist.

Priya (CS): acct: VER-1147-prod. Timeframe: 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC -> 2026-04-04 08:00 UTC for QPS bump. Hosted endpoint is fine (no private install). They're demoing internal tooling only.

Kara (SRE): We have spare capacity in apac-sg1 but at 5k QPS we should pin to a quantized model to keep p95 low. Which model exactly? We'll also want a 15m canary before full promotion. No blockers otherwise.

Marco (Sales): I'll join the demo and push renewal. If we get APAC latency proof they'll likely move to Dedicated. Priya — can you get the attendee list so I can prep exec materials?

Priya (CS): Vernon confirmed model: gpt-3.5-revX. Attendees are internal. I'll get the list and share.

Kara (SRE): Plan: (1) ACL: allow 203.0.113.0/24 + 198.51.100.45 -> service redwood-hosted-apac (ACL-VER-1147-042) (2) deploy model-pin gpt-3.5-revX-quant-v2 to apac-sg1 (3) route traffic to a dedicated pool with qps=5000, burst=6500 (4) schedule auto-revoke job and incident alert if error-rate > 2% during window. I'll wait for Ethan to confirm runbook.

Ethan (Onboard): Confirmed. I updated the onboarding runbook at /runbooks/ver-1147/apac-demo.md with the checklist and rollback steps. CC Kara: infra commands below for SRE to apply.

Ethan (Onboard): ```bash
# infra CLI
redwood infra acl add --account VER-1147 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --note "Vernon demo 2026-04-02" --expires 2026-04-05T08:00Z
redwood infra acl add --account VER-1147 --ip 198.51.100.45 --expires 2026-04-05T08:00Z
redwood infra region enable --region apac-sg1 --account VER-1147 --model-pin gpt-3.5-revX-quant-v2
redwood infra qps set --account VER-1147 --limit 5000 --burst 6500 --window 48h
```

Kara (SRE): Applying ACLs and spinning up a small canary pool now. Will run 15m smoke and post metrics. If canary looks good I'll promote to full pool and schedule auto-revoke at 2026-04-05T08:00Z. :thumbsup:

InfraBot: Region enablement job queued (job id J-39821). ETA ~12m.

Priya (CS): Thanks team. Marco — if renewal needs leverage, I'll offer a one-time enablement credit and capture feedback: Vernon asked for clearer APAC latency docs. I'll draft a short blurb.

Kara (SRE): Canary results: p95 ~120ms, error-rate 0.4%, token throughput within expected envelope. Promoting to full pool. ACLs and qps rules applied. Auto-revoke job scheduled for 2026-04-05T08:00Z. Ops note: ACL tag ACL-VER-1147-042, job J-39821.

Priya (CS): Vernon confirmed demo success and said APAC latency looked great. They're very interested in Dedicated for APAC now — Marco can start renewal conversation. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
